binary_identity.access: identity copied from committed analysis metadata; SPORE and executable were not read or modified by this artifact pass

findings.cause: This is the external-only manager/iterator reconciliation, not a set of missing canonical executable functions.
findings.finding: The range is exactly 121 contiguous unique EXTERNAL manager entries (0x7b through 0xf3), and every row is noncanonical and external.

findings.cause: No identity was guessed for the null-name rows, and no matching external edge exists in the committed snapshot.
findings.finding: Ninety-seven rows have committed allowlist identities; 24 rows have explicitly unavailable names/identities, and those 24 are exactly the zero-xref rows.

findings.cause: Committed xref edges are tokenized by external DLL/name identity and scanned from canonical caller bodies only.
findings.finding: The 97 identified rows have 2,586 canonicalized external xrefs from 623 distinct canonical caller functions; all 24 unknown rows have snapshot-bounded zero xrefs.

findings.cause: These are static edge counts only; they do not establish execution frequency, API behavior, or gameplay semantics.
findings.finding: Fan-in is concentrated at TlsGetValue (2,061 xrefs, 315 callers), QueryPerformanceCounter (123, 106), and LeaveCriticalSection (111, 70).

findings.cause: Gameplay relevance is restricted to canonical caller-category overlap; no semantics are inferred from the external API name.
findings.finding: Only QueryPerformanceCounter overlaps callers classified GAMEPLAY_LOGIC: three committed caller VAs (0062bf10, 00b322c0, 00f97ef0).

findings.cause: External implementations are outside SporeApp.exe and the committed canonical export does not contain executable bodies or outgoing edges for EXTERNAL records.
findings.finding: All 121 entries are distinct Ghidra external function records, while body size, section/block, outgoing callees, thunk/stub/generated status, and runtime validation remain unavailable or not established.

methodology.body_and_location: Unavailable fields remain null with reason references; EXTERNAL is recorded as an address space, not a section/block.
methodology.callee_count: Always null in this range because the committed exporter scans canonical caller bodies only; it is not encoded as zero.
methodology.caller_count: Count distinct canonical caller_va values in committed xref edges for the row identity token.
methodology.callsites: Include every available sorted callsite_va. Empty arrays are snapshot-bounded observed zero, not unavailable data.
methodology.distinctness: A unique EXTERNAL FunctionManager entry is a distinct Ghidra function record, not evidence of a body or distinct external implementation.
methodology.gameplay_relevance: Join caller VAs to S5 and count only GAMEPLAY_LOGIC or GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT. External API names are not assigned gameplay semantics.
methodology.ordering: Rows are sorted by entry; caller, callsite, gameplay-caller, source, finding, and object-key order is deterministic.
methodology.reachability: Report committed incoming-reference presence only; entry-point and runtime reachability remain null.
methodology.reference_xref_count: Count committed canonicalized xref edges by external identity token. For explicitly unknown rows, use the source reconciliation zero plus absence from the complete 362-token external allowlist.
methodology.selection: Take rows from S0 whose EXTERNAL ordinal is 0x7b through 0xf3 inclusive; preserve entry, VA, and name exactly.
methodology.zero_vs_null: Zero is used only for observed committed xref/caller/triage counts. Body size, callees, section/block, thunk/stub/generated flags, and runtime validation use null plus reasons.

R1.reason: The implementation is external to SporeApp.exe and the committed reconciliation exposes no size for EXTERNAL rows; null is not zero.

R10.reason: Distinct means a unique Ghidra external FunctionManager record/entry, not a distinct executable body or recovered implementation.

R2.reason: The source section/block fields are null and no committed external memory-block metadata is available; EXTERNAL is an address space, not a section or block.

R3.reason: The committed exporter enumerates instructions only for the 58,757 canonical caller VAs; it does not export bodies or outgoing edges for external function records.

R4.reason: The source marks is_thunk null and supplies no stub/generated evidence; external=true is not silently converted into any of those labels.

R5.reason: The records are static external imports; the committed campaign states no function-level runtime validation is available.

R6.reason: Committed incoming xrefs establish static references, not entry-point or runtime reachability; zero means no matching edge in this snapshot, not proven unreachable.

R7.reason: External API names are identity evidence only. Gameplay relevance is limited to canonical caller-category overlap and makes no semantic claim about the API.

R8.reason: The source row explicitly has null name and null identity source; no DLL or API identity was inferred.

R9.reason: The source reconciliation records zero external xrefs, and the row is absent from the complete 362-token external allowlist; this is snapshot-bounded zero evidence.
